name: Orphan
flavor: Raised by a temple that took in foundlings.
perk: Once per long rest, you can calm one frightened creature you can touch (it ends the frightened condition).
bio: You grew up in a temple that took in foundlings.

name: Nobility
flavor: Raised in a noble house, giving orders from childhood.
perk: Once per long rest, you can call on your family name to gain lodging, an audience or a small favour.
bio: You grew up comfortably among castle walls, giving orders from childhood.

name: Nomad
flavor: Raised on the move, never staying anywhere long.
perk: You never get lost while travelling overland, and you need half the usual rest to recover from a forced march.
bio: You grew up on the move, never staying anywhere long.

name: Theater Troupe
flavor: Raised on the road with players and tricksters.
perk: You gain proficiency in Showmanship, and you can change your look with stage paint during a short rest.
bio: You grew up on the road with players and tricksters.

name: Merchant Caravan
flavor: Raised haggling at the wagons of a trading caravan.
perk: You always know the fair price of common goods, and you buy and sell them 10% better.
bio: You grew up haggling at the wagons of a trading caravan.

name: River-Barge Family
flavor: Raised working the barges with your kin.
perk: You gain a swim speed equal to half your speed, and you never suffer motion sickness.
bio: You grew up working the river barges with your kin.

name: Archive Scribes
flavor: Raised copying and guarding texts in an archive.
perk: You learn two extra languages.
bio: You grew up copying and guarding the texts of an archive.

name: Frontier Hunters
flavor: Raised in a hunting camp on the edge of settled land.
perk: You have advantage on checks to track beasts.
bio: You grew up in a hunting camp on the edge of settled land.

name: City Guild Apprentice
flavor: Apprenticed young to a crafting guild.
perk: You gain proficiency with one artisan's tool of your choice.
bio: You grew up as a young apprentice in a city crafting guild.

name: Plague-Ward Healers
flavor: Raised among the healers of a sickhouse.
perk: You have advantage on saves against disease, and you can identify any poison by smell.
bio: You grew up among the healers of a sickhouse.

name: Border Garrison
flavor: Raised inside a fort on a contested border.
perk: While you keep watch during a rest, you and your allies can't be surprised.
bio: You grew up inside a fort on a contested border.

name: Hermit's Ward
flavor: Taught alone by a reclusive caster.
perk: Once per long rest, you can ask the GM one yes-or-no question about a place you can see.
bio: You grew up alone, taught by a reclusive caster.

name: Lighthouse Keepers
flavor: Raised tending a storm-coast lighthouse.
perk: You can see through rain, fog and snow as if they weren't there, out to 60 ft.
bio: You grew up tending a lighthouse on a stormy coast.

name: Highland Shepherds
flavor: Raised driving flocks through high pastures.
perk: Nonmagical cold never harms you, and beasts of the herd follow your calls.
bio: You grew up driving flocks through the high pastures.

name: Fighting Pits
flavor: Raised fighting in the pits for coin and food.
perk: Once per long rest, when you spend Hit Dice, regain 1 extra Hit Die worth of HP.
bio: You grew up fighting in the pits for coin and food.

name: Marsh Fosterage
flavor: Fostered by marsh folk who brewed with what grew there.
perk: You can brew one basic poison or antidote dose during each long rest, using marsh plants.
bio: You grew up fostered by marsh folk who brewed with what grew there.

name: Gravedigger's Yard
flavor: Raised among the gravediggers of a burial ground.
perk: As an action, you can sense undead within 30 ft (1 per short rest).
bio: You grew up among the gravediggers of a burial ground.

name: Self-Taught Stray
flavor: Raised by no one, so you taught yourself.
perk: Gain +1 spell known. It still counts against your highest spell level.
bio: You grew up with no one to raise you, so you taught yourself.

name: Smugglers' Den
flavor: Raised among smugglers who ran goods at night.
perk: You have advantage on Stealth checks in dim light or darkness.
bio: You grew up among smugglers who ran goods by night.

name: Solitary
flavor: Lives apart and reshapes themselves alone.
perk: Alone you learned to remake yourself: your Transmute spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: You spend your days apart from others, reshaping yourself alone.

name: Protector
flavor: Stands between others and harm.
perk: Guarding others comes naturally: your Seal spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: You spend your days standing between others and harm.

name: Hero
flavor: Seeks out danger to lift others up.
perk: Lifting others up is second nature: your Bless spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: You spend your days seeking out danger to lift others up.

name: Delinquent
flavor: Breaks every rule put in front of them.
perk: No rule holds you for long: your Break spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: You spend your days breaking every rule put in front of you.

name: Criminal
flavor: Works angles, deals and fixes for a living.
perk: Every deal is a lever: your Manipulate spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: You spend your days working angles, deals and fixes for a living.

name: Brawler
flavor: Settles things head-on and hard.
perk: You hit first and hardest: your Evoke spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: You spend your days settling things head-on and hard.

name: Con Artist
flavor: Lives behind a string of false faces.
perk: A false face fits you well: your Illusion spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: You spend your days behind a string of false faces.

name: Wanderer
flavor: Lives off whatever the road provides.
perk: The road always provides: your Conjure spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: You spend your days wandering from town to town, living off the road.

name: Artisan
flavor: Lives to build and make things.
perk: Your hands know how to make: your Create spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: You spend your days building and making things.

name: Grudge-Keeper
flavor: Lives to pay back every wrong.
perk: You never forget a wrong: your Curse spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: You spend your days paying back every wrong done to you.

name: Caretaker
flavor: Lives looking after the sick and the weak.
perk: Mending others is your craft: your Restore spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: You spend your days looking after the sick and the weak.

name: Beastkeeper
flavor: Lives with animals and calls them kin.
perk: Your kin answer when called: your Summon spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: You spend your days among animals you call kin.

name: Commander
flavor: Lives to lead and be obeyed.
perk: Others are used to obeying you: your Subjugate spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: You spend your days leading others and being obeyed.

name: Enforcer
flavor: Keeps others in line by holding them down.
perk: You know how to hold someone down: your Bind spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: You spend your days keeping others in line by holding them down.

name: Free Spirit
flavor: Lives unbound by ties or promises.
perk: Nothing keeps you tied: your Release spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: You spend your days unbound by ties or promises.

name: Ravager
flavor: Lives by tearing down whatever stands.
perk: Ruin follows in your wake: your Destroy spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: You spend your days tearing down whatever still stands.

name: Confident
flavor: Sure of their own strength.
perk: Certainty fuels your force: your Evoke spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: Your confident outlook leaves you sure of your own strength.

name: Defiant
flavor: Refuses any limit set on them.
perk: Limits exist to be broken: your Break spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: Your defiant outlook refuses any limit set on you.

name: Hopeful
flavor: Believes things will turn out well.
perk: Your faith in good outcomes shows: your Bless spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: Your hopeful outlook tells you things will turn out well.

name: Secretive
flavor: Shows no one who they really are.
perk: Hiding is habit: your Illusion spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: Your secretive outlook shows no one who you really are.

name: Curious
flavor: Always wants to see what comes next.
perk: Your wonder calls things forth: your Conjure spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: Your curious outlook always wants to see what comes next.

name: Calculated
flavor: Weighs every move before making it.
perk: Every move is planned: your Manipulate spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: Your calculated outlook weighs every move before you make it.

name: Visionary
flavor: Sees what could be built.
perk: You see what could be: your Create spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: Your visionary outlook sees what could be built.

name: Cautious
flavor: Guards against every risk.
perk: You shut every door behind you: your Seal spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: Your cautious outlook guards against every risk.

name: Bitter
flavor: Feels the world owes them.
perk: Your resentment takes shape: your Curse spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: Your bitter outlook says the world owes you.

name: Modest
flavor: Thinks little of themselves, much of others.
perk: You give more than you take: your Restore spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: Your modest outlook on life leaves you happy with what you have.

name: Devoted
flavor: Defines themselves by who they serve or stand with.
perk: Those you serve answer you: your Summon spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: Your devoted outlook defines you by who you serve and stand with.

name: Proud
flavor: Sees themselves above others.
perk: You expect others to bow: your Subjugate spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: Your proud outlook sets you above others.

name: Self-Loathing
flavor: Wishes they were someone else.
perk: You long to be someone else: your Transmute spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: Your self-loathing outlook wishes you were someone else.

name: Greedy
flavor: Wants to hold on to everything.
perk: What you grab, you keep: your Bind spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: Your greedy outlook wants to hold on to everything.

name: Carefree
flavor: Lets nothing weigh on them.
perk: You let everything go: your Release spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: Your carefree outlook lets nothing weigh on you.

name: Nihilistic
flavor: Sees nothing worth keeping.
perk: Nothing is worth keeping: your Destroy spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
bio: Your nihilistic outlook sees nothing worth keeping.
